name: Priya Sharma
headline: Senior Product Manager
paragraphs: Tulip Commerce helps 25,000 online merchants across Europe get paid at checkout. That is the problem I have worked on at Kestrel Payments since 2022, so your Product Manager, Merchant Checkout role is a close match.

At Kestrel Payments I led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers to rebuild our merchant checkout. Payment success rose from 91% to 96%, and moving to a 2-step UPI and card flow cut drop-off from 38% to 24%. I also launched subscription billing for 1,200 SMB merchants in 5 months.

I talk to merchants every week and use A/B tests to decide what ships. At Brightpath Learning that habit grew paid conversion from 2.1% to 3.4%. I have not worked with iDEAL yet, so I would start by learning it from your merchant data and payments team.
I am based in Pune and ready to relocate to Amsterdam. As an IND recognised sponsor, Tulip Commerce can follow the usual highly skilled migrant process. I would welcome a conversation.
